description:
The National Shipbuilding Research Program (NSRP) Executive Control Board (ECB), under the Joint Funding Agreement, N00024-18-3-2231, intends to issue NSRP Research Announcement 27 (RA-27) and NSRP Panel Project Announcement (PP-27). Subsequent release of these solicitations will also be announced on SAM.gov. The RA, PP and any amendments thereto shall be posted on the NSRP website (www.nsrp.org). See attachment for more detail.


******The Original Date Offers Due: Dec 01, 2026 in SAM.gov is not correct. The actual dates for proposal submittal will be posted on the NSRP website.*****
